subject: Re: Quick demo? Self-signup — use case + volume
messages:
From: Matt Green <matt@greenwave.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — GreenWave signup

Hi Tessa,

I signed up for Redwood earlier today (account: GreenWave AI) and wanted to see if we could get a quick demo to understand fit. High level: we’re building an internal assistant for customer support that combines retrieval + generation.

Quick context:
- Primary use case: Answering user support tickets + suggested replies (mix of retrieval + short generation).
- Volume: currently ~120k user queries/day (expected to grow to 300k/day in 6 months). Typical prompt length ~120 tokens; expected output ~60 tokens.
- Concurrency: spikes during business hours, peaking ~35 concurrent requests.
- Timeline: aiming to pilot in Q3 and make a decision by end of Q3.

I attached a small CSV with query buckets. Can we book a 30-minute walkthrough next week? Prefer PST mornings.

Thanks —Matt
Matt Green
Head of ML, GreenWave AI
matt@greenwave.ai
Attachment: sample_query_buckets.csv (CSV)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Matt Green <matt@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — GreenWave signup

Thanks for signing up and for the context, Matt — great to meet you. I’m Tessa on the SDR team, and I’ll coordinate the intro/demo. Ben (cc’d) will run the walkthrough. A couple of quick questions so Ben can tailor the session: 

1) Retrieval vs generation split: are you expecting the assistant to be ~80% retrieval with shorter generation, or closer to 50/50?
2) Latency & SLA expectations: do you have a P95 or max latency target for interactive replies (e.g., <250ms, <500ms)?
3) Data residency / SSO: do you need data residency (EU/US) or SSO for the demo environment?
4) Sandbox access: would you like a demo sandbox with a small dataset preloaded, or just a product walkthrough first?

I can propose a few 30-minute slots (all PST) — please confirm your timezone:
- Tue 5/18 9:30–10:00 AM PT
- Wed 5/19 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu 5/20 8:30–9:00 AM PT

If none of those work, tell me 2–3 windows that do and we’ll match. Agenda we usually follow:
- 5 min quick intro + product fit
- 15 min demo (retrieval & prompt flow)
- 10 min ramp/cost/next steps + sandbox options

Attachments: quick prep checklist (I’ll include after we lock a time).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
From: Matt Green <matt@greenwave.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — GreenWave signup

Hi Tessa — thanks. Answering inline: 
1) Retrieval vs generation: roughly 70% retrieval, 30% short generations (templates + personalization).
2) Latency: aiming for P95 < 400ms for the user-facing replies; background async jobs can be slower.
3) Data residency/SSO: US data residency is fine for now; SSO would be good but not a blocker for pilot.
4) Sandbox: yes, a sandbox with a few example tickets would be ideal so we can validate latency and prompt templates.

Any of the slots you proposed work, prefer Tue 5/18 9:30 AM PT. I attached a short PDF with annotated example queries and a note about peak times. Can Ben confirm he can cover retrieval latency aspects?

Cheers,
Matt
Attachment: annotated_examples.pdf (PDF)

Perfect — locked for Tue 5/18 9:30–10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent (link below). Ben will lead the demo and focus on retrieval performance and sandbox options; I’ll cover next steps and sandbox provisioning.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
